import Fastify from 'fastify';
import fp from 'fastify-plugin';

const app = Fastify();

const routes = async (server) => {
  server.get('/items', listItems);
};

const wrappedRoutes = fp(routes);
const registerableRoutes = wrappedRoutes;

app.register(registerableRoutes, { prefix: '/v1' });

function listItems(req, reply) {
  reply.send([]);
}
